lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Monday's Open Space Commission, which takes up three real decisions on the Valley Floor — including which of three trail alignments moves forward for Reach 1 and whether the Telluride Mountain Club gets permission to route a quarter-mile of trail through that corridor. Thursday brings a joint Planning Commission and BOCC work session where county staff and elected officials will work through proposed Land Use Code changes covering forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but the direction set in work sessions like this tends to stick.

notable.stake: Commission chooses among three Valley Floor trail routes; Mountain Club reroute also on table.
Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condo plats get shaped here.
